name: fork_1_phase2_learned_bedtime_moves_the_setback
description: Fork Dunky13#1 phase 2 (docs/preference-learning-spec.md). The household's learned weekday bedtime is 80 minutes after the configured 22:30. Preference learning is on, so the bedtime setback is applied at the learned 23:50 and the thermostat is left at the comfort heat setpoint at 22:30, exactly as a household with a 23:50 bedtime wants.
source: docs/preference-learning-spec.md, Phase 2, Seam: effective_times and schedule_at; timers re-register at the learned instants.
notes: Occupant impact: someone who goes to bed at 23:50 stays at the comfort temperature until then instead of the house cooling down at the configured 22:30.

The learned shift is seeded with the harness hook learned_schedule; the 23:50 bedtime event is the point-in-time timer the coordinator arms for the learned instant (the 22:30 clock timer is not armed).
Effectiveness: with the seam ignored the setback is written at 22:30 and the first assertion (no write before 23:50) fails.

assertions.reason: The configured 22:30 passes without a setback write: the learned bedtime is 23:50.
At the learned bedtime the setback is written.

verdict.summary: The bedtime setback follows the learned bedtime, not the configured one.
verdict.observed_behavior: No setpoint write until 23:50, then the 64 F setback.
verdict.expected_behavior: The setback is applied at the learned bedtime (configured 22:30 + 80 min).
